consumer: game::handle_action's ACTION_MOVE_* dispatch site, which performs the registered east-move by calling avatar_action::move(u,m,dest_delta) and lets the turn loop charge the tick.
scope: not applicable -- a single registered planar movement action dispatched through the engine's own active input loop, not an item/region query
decisive_source: src/handle_action.cpp::game::handle_action (ACTION_MOVE_*) -- its body calls avatar_action::move(u,m,dest_delta) and on success defers the turn cost to the engine's turn loop, the real keypress code path.
divergence: After requesting east, a wall (impassable terrain) sits directly east: the real action returns moved=false, clears destination, and costs no turn / no position change; a shortcut that teleports the avatar east and decrements moves would wrongly show the avatar one tile east through the wall.
